text: Plan our summer holiday with the kids

title: Where to spend the summer holiday
Rent a lake house at Siljan, Dalarna

author: claude
text: Gothenburg to Siljan is about 470–520 km by car: roughly 5.5 hours to Rättvik (E20 via Örebro, then Rv 50/70) and closer to 6 hours to Mora on the west side of the lake. That's without stops; with kids, plan for 6.5–7.5 hours door to door. It's a long day but doable in one go, or it can be split with an overnight around Örebro or Karlstad. These are estimates from general knowledge, not a live route check.

reason: It's what we all want, the kids can swim and we can stay put.
